items.reason: Gap 0 names two deliveries of the same event processed concurrently before either handler finishes.
Gap 1 describes the same validly signed body arriving with a different X-Event-Id header, i.e. the header is changeable outside the signature.
Gap 2 says the provider's charge.refunded is treated as unknown so the refund is never recorded, which is the name mismatch with the registered handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
